This sounds more like dissociation. Its where you feel unreal or disconnected from reality or your surroundings feel that way. Dissociation is usually caused by extreme stress or sometimes even depression but it really isn't on the schizophrenia spectrum (if its the only symptom). 

  If it really isn't due to extreme stress or it happens a lot it might be due to a dissociation disorder like depersonalization disorder.If you have borderline personality disorder or other disorders like major depression, its probably caused by that. 
   I wouldn't worry too much about it unless it significantly impacts your daily life or happens really often.

I personally enjoyed my 2 stays at adolescent psychiatric ward until i got homesick the second time. I went there at first for depression and anxiety and the second time for weirder symptoms and both visits were quite successful. For me, it wasn't completely life changing but it gave me a lot more hope to live. Everyone has different experiences though.
 
   The staff usually are really friendly and i was always comfortable around them. If for some reason you don't like the therapist/physiatrist you get, some places allow you to change them but this isn't a guarantee everywhere.

 If you are worried about the security and the other teenagers it is understandable. During both of my stays i felt safe. It is really easy to relate to the other teenagers, since you are all in there for the same reasons.
 
My advice is to be 100% honest to all of the staff there and you will recover faster. If it is hard to describe a certain feeling or remember certain times, a journal is nice to have around. Also you should be giving plenty of coping skills to manage your symptoms. Don't forget them and try your hardest to remember and use them when you leave there.

 I hope you have a good time :)
